experience.description: Building MCP-based AI code-generation tooling, agent rules, vector search, and memory for engineering teams.
experience.techStack: AWS, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent Skills, Vector Search & Embeddings, Python
details: Building MCP servers that ground AI-driven code generation in the company's existing repositories, turning internal codebase context into reusable generative tooling for engineering teams.
Designing production-grade Agent Skills with hardened harnesses — validation, guardrails, and failure handling that make agent-generated code safe to ship, not just fast to produce.
Defining the rules that govern agent behavior in production — constraining what agents can generate and how, so autonomy doesn't come at the cost of control.
Building a semantic search layer over the company's repositories using vector embeddings, so agents retrieve real internal context instead of generating code blind to prior implementation.
Designing memory for coding agents so multi-step tasks retain context across turns, moving them from single-shot completions to sustained, context-aware collaboration.
Delivering feature/value roughly 10x faster than the prior baseline through this AI-assisted engineering tooling.

experience.description: Founding Engineer leading cloud architecture, GenAI, and DevSecOps on a financial technology platform.
experience.techStack: GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, VPC, Secret Manager), Terraform, Python, FastAPI, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Vertex AI
details: Founding engineer — designed the GCP architecture and delivered the company's first production MVP, enabling onboarding of multiple enterprise clients.
Designed and delivered AI model deployment pipelines (GitLab CI/CD → Cloud Build → Artifact Registry → Cloud Run), cutting deployment time by ~70%.
Built production multi-agent AI systems with LlamaIndex and LangGraph — session management, state machines, event orchestration, and RAG pipelines.
Built real-time and batch ETL/ELT pipelines using Dataflow (Apache Beam), Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions and Composer serving millions of daily events.
Delivered full IaC coverage with Terraform modules (Cloud Run, VPC, IAM, Secret Manager, Serverless VPC connectors) — zero manual infra provisioning.
Established company-wide DevSecOps standards: CI/CD boilerplates, secret rotation, SAST/DAST scanning, and naming conventions adopted across all teams.
Mentored 4+ engineers on GCP, Terraform, and GenAI architecture; raised overall team engineering maturity level.

experience.description: Designing scalable backend services and event-driven architectures.
experience.techStack: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EC2, Kinesis Firehose, CodePipeline, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CloudFront, VPC, IAM), Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Serverless, SCRUM & Jira
details: Founding engineer — designed and delivered the company's first logistics platform MVP on AWS, enabling the first 3 enterprise client onboardings.
Architected AWS cloud infrastructure using CloudFormation and C4 methodology for 99.9% availability across ECS, RDS, Lambda, and API Gateway.
Built multi-tenant SaaS backend using hexagonal architecture and DDD — with cursor-based pagination, caching, and JWT/OAuth2 auth.
Built RESTful microservices on ECS/EC2, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, and S3 to handle high-throughput logistics event streams reliably.
Reduced deployment cycle by ~60% by establishing CodeBuild + CodePipeline CI/CD with automated Pytest and Locust load-test gates.
Mentored 3 backend engineers on AWS, clean architecture, and test-driven development practices.

experience.description: Engineering Lead setting frontend architecture and GraphQL standards that the team adopted org-wide.
experience.techStack: React, GraphQL, Apollo Client, Figma, Node.js, TypeScript, SCRUM & Jira
details: Set technical direction as Tech Lead for frontend architecture, replacing scattered, ad hoc data-fetching patterns with a single React/GraphQL approach the team standardized on.

Designed a GraphQL proxy layer with Apollo Client that decoupled frontend components from inconsistent backend data shapes, removing duplicated fetching and caching logic scattered across the codebase.
Introduced a Figma prototyping step ahead of implementation, catching design/data-model mismatches before they became engineering rework.
Established a React Testing Library/Jest testing standard for the frontend, moving core user flows from untested to covered and enforced in review.
Mentored team members in React, GraphQL, and TanStack, shortening ramp-up time for engineers new to the stack and reducing their dependence on senior review.
Recognition: Bravo Team Awards for team contributions.

experience.description: Designed Scalable Serverless Architectures & Data-Driven Microservices.
experience.techStack: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EC2), Python, NodeJs, Fast API, Java (Spring), Serverless, SCRUM & Jira
details: Led full-stack delivery across multiple product teams, owning features end-to-end from schema design through deployment under tight release cycles.
Designed the relational schema (ER-modeled) behind the platform's matching and relationship logic — the core data model every downstream service built on.
Architected event-driven serverless microservices on AWS Lambda so infrastructure scaled with highly variable user traffic instead of running over-provisioned and idle.
Designed the public-facing REST and GraphQL API contract — auth, rate limiting, cursor pagination, JSON:API conventions — that external and internal clients integrated against.
Extended the backend into Java/Spring where existing integrations required it, keeping those services maintained alongside the primary Python/Node.js stack.
Established CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline + GitHub Actions) cutting manual release effort by ~50%.
Built the integration layer connecting the React frontend to Python/Node.js backend services, giving frontend and backend teams a stable contract to ship against independently.
Took the product's core monetization path from concept to production — integrating PayPal/Stripe payments and designing the shugarapp.com React frontend end-to-end.
Designed and shipped ML-backed microservices (Python/Flask/FastAPI) powering conversational chatbot features, extending the platform beyond CRUD into applied ML.
